\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 211-213 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R216-first-pass-words-from-chapters-211-213}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for turmeric and cumin.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item failure, experience, a choice, a decision, a possibility
  \item an application, an envelope; a wallet, an address, a salary, a guide
  \item a fountain, a gate, a fence, a cellar, a loft
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Failure? (\textbf{\mr{अपयश}}, \emph{apayaś}.) Experience? (\textbf{\mr{अनुभव}}, \emph{anubhav}.) A choice? (\textbf{\mr{निवड}}, \emph{nivaḍ}.) A decision? (\textbf{\mr{निर्णय}}, \emph{nirṇay}.) A possibility? (\textbf{\mr{शक्यता}}, \emph{śakyatā}.) An application? (\textbf{\mr{अर्ज}}, \emph{arj}.) An envelope; a wallet? (\textbf{\mr{पाकीट}}, \emph{pākīṭ}.) An address? (\textbf{\mr{पत्ता}}, \emph{pattā}.) A salary? (\textbf{\mr{पगार}}, \emph{pagār}.) A guide? (\textbf{\mr{मार्गदर्शक}}, \emph{mārgadarśak}.) A fountain? (\textbf{\mr{कारंजे}}, \emph{kārañje}.) A gate? (\textbf{\mr{फाटक}}, \emph{phāṭak}.) A fence? (\textbf{\mr{कुंपण}}, \emph{kumpaṇ}.) A cellar? (\textbf{\mr{तळघर}}, \emph{taḷghar}.) A loft? (\textbf{\mr{माळा}}, \emph{māḷā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 214-216 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R216-second-pass-words-from-chapters-214-216}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item energy, plastic, cotton, wool, silk
  \item a player, a coach, a supporter, arrival, departure
  \item shrikhand, buttermilk, a spice mix, turmeric, cumin
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Energy? (\textbf{\mr{ऊर्जा}}, \emph{ūrjā}.) Plastic? (\textbf{\mr{प्लास्टिक}}, \emph{plāsṭik}.) Cotton? (\textbf{\mr{कापूस}}, \emph{kāpūs}.) Wool? (\textbf{\mr{लोकर}}, \emph{lokar}.) Silk? (\textbf{\mr{रेशीम}}, \emph{reśīm}.) A player? (\textbf{\mr{खेळाडू}}, \emph{kheḷāḍū}.) A coach? (\textbf{\mr{प्रशिक्षक}}, \emph{praśikṣak}.) A supporter? (\textbf{\mr{चाहता}}, \emph{cāhtā}.) Arrival? (\textbf{\mr{आगमन}}, \emph{āgaman}.) Departure? (\textbf{\mr{प्रस्थान}}, \emph{prasthān}.) Shrikhand? (\textbf{\mr{श्रीखंड}}, \emph{śrīkhaṇḍ}.) Buttermilk? (\textbf{\mr{ताक}}, \emph{tāk}.) A spice mix? (\textbf{\mr{मसाला}}, \emph{masālā}.) Turmeric? (\textbf{\mr{हळद}}, \emph{haḷad}.) Cumin? (\textbf{\mr{जिरे}}, \emph{jire}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
